notes.title: JETRUNNER Launch Trailer, Demo Update & Competition!
notes.notes: [h2]We're approaching the finish line![/h2][p][/p][p]The launch of a new action platformer is almost here. JETRUNNER launches on Steam September 4, 2025.[/p][p]Join rising star, Nina, played by Sara Secora, on her journey to the top of the leaderboard. She’s joined by our star-studded cast with the voice talents of Matthew Mercer as the jetrunning commentator, Mick Acaster, and Alejandro Saab as Jacque, the childhood best friend of up-and-coming JETRUNNER, Nina.[/p][p]Watch the launch trailer below that focuses on the growing relationship between Nina and her commentator, Mick, as Nina goes from rookie off the streets to a jetrunning legend.[/p][previewyoutube="mc--iNgQyow;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Also, we have teamed up with [url="https://Speedrun.com"]Speedrun.com[/url] to host a launch competition where participants have the opportunity to claim from the $2000 prize pool.[/p][p][/p][p]The event will begin on launch day and starts September 4, 2025 @ 4:00 PM UTC / 12:00 PM ET. The event concludes on September 11, 2025 @ 11:59 PM UTC / 7:59 PM ET.[/p][p][/p][p][b]More details on how to take part will be announced on September 1, 2025.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]We're also updating our demo at [b]18:00 (Oslo Time)[/b] so you can get a head start on the action, check here for the patch notes:[/p][list][*][p]Limited access to 5 additional levels! See the start of New York featuring Matthew Mercer as commentator Mick Acaster.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved animations with revolutionary Jet Hands System[/p][/*][*][p]Added voice module to targets and a new volume slider for it[/p][/*][*][p]Movement changes[/p][list][*][p]Swingbars now block wall running[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue with jumping in slopes[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed jump issue with coyote time[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Made environments more alive with ambient sounds[/p][/*][*][p]Improved audio mix[/p][/*][*][p]Added coffee parrying[/p][/*][*][p]On-screen input actions should now display the correct input[/p][/*][*][p]Added a stats screen[/p][/*][*][p]More improvements and fixes[/p][/*][*][p]Removed coffee parrying[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Godspeed jetrunners![/p]

notes.title: JETRUNNER New Trailer & Demo Update
notes.notes:
[h2]Welcome Jetrunners![/h2]

As part of the [b]Best Indie Games Showcase[/b], [i][b]JETRUNNER [/b][/i]is back with a bang! An all new [b]Official Announcement Trailer[/b] showcases the high-octane thrills [b][i]JETRUNNER [/i][/b]has to offer as you run, jump, slide, and shoot your way to becoming a jetrunning legend.

[i][b]JETRUNNER[/b][/i] boasts a star-studded cast including [b]Matthew Mercer [/b]as the game’s commentator, Mick Acaster, and [b]Alejandro Saab[/b] as protagonist Nina’s lifelong childhood friend, Jacques.

Get a taste of the action with the [b]Official Announcement Trailer[/b] below:

[previewyoutube=qsL2ElBW1mA;full][/previewyoutube]

[i][b]JETRUNNER [/b][/i]will also be taking part in [b]Steam Next Fest [/b]between June 9th-16th where players can take on an all-new demo build of the game with 5 challenging tracks to get their best time on.

New to the demo:
[list]
[*] Voice lines! Now our players can get the taste of JETRUNNER’s story and a glimpse of what’s coming in the full game.
[*] The public Demo will now have 5 tracks from the Prologue: The Queen of New York.
[*] Animated portrait of Nina:now she’s more alive than ever!
[/list]
Why this update matters:
We’re getting JETRUNNER ready for the full launch (more news on that soon), and we want every new player to get a solid first impression of what the game is all about.

What’s next:
Meanwhile we’re working on more content for our players and polishing what’s already there! 

We’ve got lots more to showcase in the coming weeks so keep your eyes peeled for more [i][b]JETRUNNER[/b][/i] content!

Join the community [url=https://discord.gg/vC2sfbqmpZ]Discord[/url] for sneak peaks and post your times.

Until next time, godspeed jetrunners

notes.title: Patch Notes 21/08/24
notes.notes:
A new build for the JETRUNNER demo went live today with some new features, fixes and improvements! The demo store page is now live and open for reviews, so try out the demo now and leave a review if you'd like!

[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Items will now respawn when used (after a short delay)

[b]Note[/b] - We have observed several occurences where items have been used "unsuccessfully" and then the only option is to restart the level. In general, we want players to always be able to finish a level without restarting, and we believe this change helps with that.

[*] Changes to wall run settings
[list]
[*] [i]Auto jump[/i] setting no longer dependent on [i]hold input[/i] setting
[*] Auto jump when reaching the end of a wall should now work correctly when using the setting
[/list]
[*] Option to show/hide build ID is now implemented
[*] Made some jumps more forgiving
[*] FIxed some performance issues
[*] Fixed weapon ammo counter not always rendering correctly
[*] You can now spice up the environment with some grafitti
[*] Other fixes and improvements
[/list]
